**What this changes**
A sentence or two.

**Why**
The problem it solves, or the issue it closes (e.g. `Closes #12`).

**Checklist**
- [ ] `npm test` passes (no dependencies, no `npm install` needed).
- [ ] New behaviour has tests. Parser/resolver changes especially — see `test/`.
- [ ] No new runtime dependencies (the zero-dependency property is enforced in CI).
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour or configuration changed (README env table, etc.).
